name: Bean sprouts
description: Sprouted mung beans — crisp, watery, thrown in at the last second.

tcm.note: Dou ya clears heat and drains damp, like the mung bean it comes from.

ayurveda.note: Sprouting lightens an already shita bean.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; moong is the coolest of the dals.

histamine.note: Low, but sprouts spoil quickly and are a food-safety risk when old — a different problem from histamine.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
